lines: At seven forty two tomorrow, every woman and girl on Earth disappears. Here is what happens.
Day one. Women are about seventy percent of the world's health and social care workers. Hospitals run on a handful.
Week one. Women do seventy six percent of all unpaid care work. Sixteen billion hours a day. It all stops.
Month one. Two in five workers gone. Supply chains break. Men could learn these jobs. But not four billion, in a week.
Year ten. No women, no births. No technology can carry a pregnancy outside a body. Humanity ends in about a century.
It is a thought experiment about respect. See the work. Say her name in the comments.
